text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Today our oil flows through the Turkish port of Ceyhan and the Iraqi southern terminal of Mina al-Bakr.
- Flow of oil is the first step towards ending the whole U.N. embargo on Iraq.
- Head of the U.N. oil inspectors expresses satisfaction over performance of Mina al-Bakr oil terminal in southern Iraq.
- Celebrations in Kirkuk and Basra over oil exports.
- China says will work for lifting all sanctions on Iraq.
- Industry Ministry backs efforts by the ministries of oil and transport to get oil flowing again and handle food imports.
- Russian firms are holding talks in Baghdad to buy oil.
- Iraq is holding talks with Jordan to increase trade.
- Foreign businessmen in Baghdad trying to conclude trade deals with Iraq.
- U.N. oil overseers start their work in Mina al-Bakr oil terminal.
